```{r}

pkgload::load_all(Sys.getenv("APATABLES_PKG_ROOT"), quiet = TRUE)
blk1 <- lm(sales ~ adverts + airplay, data = album)
```

LaTeX reporting its own text block, so the test can read the page this
document really has instead of the page apaTables believes it has.

```{=latex}
\noindent APALINEWIDTH=\the\linewidth\par
\noindent APATEXTHEIGHT=\the\textheight\par
```

A wide table and a narrow one, both laid out by the ladder: whatever it
decides, xelatex must report no overfull box for either.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-wide
#| tbl-cap: "Wide"
#| apa-note: "A note under the wide table."
#| warning: false
apa.reg.table(blk1)$spec |> apa.quarto.pdf()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-narrow
#| tbl-cap: "Narrow"
#| apa-note: "A note under the narrow table."

```
